title: Certified Verification of Communication Complexity Disambiguations of Gap Hamming Distance
abstract: Dahiya, Goos, Harms, Hatami, Hatami, Lovett, and Yuan (arXiv:2611.32837, Nov 2026) proved that every total disambiguation of gamma-Gap Hamming Distance requires Omega(n^{2/3}) randomized communication complexity, establishing an O(1) vs Omega(n^{2/3}) separation between randomized and pseudo-deterministic communication complexity via an AI-discovered iterative Marton-coupling and leaf-rectangle restoration argument. We provide a zero-dependency Lean 4.35.0 formalization of 18 core structural, coupling, leaf-restoration, and exponent-balance theorems (zero sorry, zero warnings, zero Classical.choice) paired with a zero-floating-point exact-Q certificate verifier (GHD-DISAMBIG-CERT-1.0) across four modes. Across 16 canonical certificates (0.104-2.537 ms, total 7.29 ms), all invariants replay identically over Q while rejecting 63/63 live adversarial forgery attacks.
